info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Risk Model Retrieval API
info.description: The Credit Risk Model Retrieval API enables financial institutions to access and retrieve credit risk models efficiently. This endpoint serves as a gateway for users to obtain specific models by providing a unique identifier. It is typically used by risk analysts and financial developers to assess risk metrics and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their decision-making processes around credit evaluations and improve their risk management strategies.

get.description: Fetches the details of the Credit Risk Model identified by RES-100045. Use this endpoint to obtain comprehensive information about the specified model, including its parameters and performance metrics.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the operations related to the credit risk model identified by RES-100045. Please ensure that the required parameters are included for a successful request.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the credit risk model details are returned.

GetCreditRiskModel_RES100045Request.description: This schema represents a request body for the GET operation related to credit risk models, specifically for resource ID RES-100045.
